Specialised High Quality Services

Hospital & Home Care

Hospital Services

  • Spirometry / FeNO / lung monitor / carbon monoxide monitor
  • Controlled oxygen therapy
  • Pulmonary rehabilitation
  • Vaccination services
  • Management of:
    • Asthma | COPD | Interstitial lung diseases
    • Pleural effusions | Pneumothorax | Tuberculosis
    • Pneumonias | COVID-19 | Smoking cessation
    • Sleep-related disorders | Allergies

Home Care Services

  • Appropriate use of inhaler technique
  • Nebulisation
  • Correct use of CPAP/BiPAP machine
  • Correct use and recording of Peak Flow Meter
  • First aid essential items / equipment support
  • Home-based oxygen therapy
